DARK-SHIP 2026-09-06 (Gabriel s138, option c): `burn.enabled` false = the aura's burn DOT is OFF and the game plays like main; the TWENTIETH turns it on. Data only - no code default. `chill.step_frames_pct` (a Float with no reader) removed: the schema-3 canonical-leaf law refuses Floats.
